instruction: A dreadnought acoustic guitar carved and joined from warm spruce and rosewood, with a rosette relief hand-cut around the sound hole and visible grain sweeping across the top. The scrolled headstock and fretted neck show fine tool facets, finished in a mellow hand-rubbed sheen.
